title: Interactive telemetry sanity prober and guided runbook wizard
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: On-call responders often need a quick, reproducible snapshot of telemetry health (metrics, traces, logs, and sampling indicators) to diagnose flaky alert sources. This PR adds a lightweight telemetry sanity prober that can be triggered interactively from the incident-bot UI or invoked via CLI/HTTP hook. It also introduces a guided runbook wizard that helps responders pick targeted remediation steps and optionally attach a minimal, privacy-safe repro bundle to the incident ticket.

What this PR does (high level): Adds a prober service that executes fast sanity checks across the metrics, traces and log ingestion paths and synthesizes a micro-snapshot (hashed metadata + truncated traces) which can be safely stored or attached to Linear/Jira. The runbook wizard walks the responder through a short decision tree (symptom classification → likely surface area → recommended playbook steps) and wires the selected steps to ephemeral automation hooks (safe restart, increase sampling, add debug flag) with manual approval gates. Includes docs, UI flows, and e2e tests.

Design notes: - Prober executes non-invasive checks only; all captured payloads are redacted and size-limited (default 64KB). - Micro-snapshot model: metric probes (latency/error percentiles), trace tailing (1 trace per service sampled), log probe (last 200 lines from correlated service), and ingestion-heartbeat checks. - Deferred capture hook: when an action like "enable debug" is chosen, the system can automatically collect a 2-minute post-action mini-snapshot and attach it to the incident (opt-in per org). - Runbook wizard content is authored as Markdown templates under docs/runbooks and is pluggable so SREs can add custom nodes.

Checklist: - [x] Prober CLI + HTTP endpoint - [x] UI wizard with decision tree and confirmation modals - [x] Micro-snapshot serializer + redaction pipeline - [x] Per-org opt-in deferred capture and retention config - [x] e2e tests that exercise happy path and privacy redaction - [x] Docs and runbook templates - [x] Chart + helm changes for optional prober sidecar

Rollout plan: - Feature gated under incident-bot experimental flag. - Phased rollout: internal SRE org → beta customers with opt-in → general availability. - Telemetry: new metrics (prober.success, prober.latency, runbook.steps_selected) and audit logs for captures.

Related: linear://ENG-1287, SUP-9821. For background see docs/internal/telemetry-prober-design.md and the incident runbook styling guide.

Notes on safety and privacy: captures are sanitized by a redaction layer that strips tokens, IPs and PII markers before storage. Admins can configure additional scrubbing rules. The default retention for micro-snapshots is 7 days and can be reduced to 0 (no storage).

Backwards compatibility: The new endpoints are additive and optional; no changes to existing alert flows.

- Add telemetry sanity prober (lightweight micro-snapshots)
- New guided runbook wizard to assist on-call responders
- Deferred post-action capture hook (opt-in)
- Admin controls for redaction and retention
- Metrics: prober.success, prober.latency, runbook.steps_selected
